1.5 : 0.8;\n\n    // Step 3: Update the score for the current mode\n    // Formula: Score_mode \u003c- 0.7 * Score_mode + 0.3 * (P * W)\n    unsigned h = solver-\u003eheuristic;\n    \n    // Safety check for heuristic index\n    if (h \u003e= 2) h = 0; \n    \n    solver-\u003emab_reward[h] = 0.7 * solver-\u003emab_reward[h] + 0.3 * (P * W);\n\n    // Step 4: Determine the next mode with Stagnation Decay\n    // For every consecutive interval the current mode fails to yield Global Progress (W=1.5),\n    // multiply its accumulated score by a penalty factor beta = 0.9.\n    if (!improved) {\n        solver-\u003emab_reward[h] *= 0.9;\n    }\n\n    // A switch naturally occurs when the penalized score drops below the inactive mode's score.\n    // We assume 2 heuristics: 0 (VSIDS) and 1 (CHB).\n    if (solver-\u003emab_reward[0] \u003e= solver-\u003emab_reward[1]) {\n        solver-\u003eheuristic = 0;\n    } else {\n        solver-\u003eheuristic = 1;\n    }\n\n    // Reset MAB tracking variables for the next phase\n    solver-\u003emab_conflicts = 0;\n    solver-\u003emab_decisions = 0;\n    solver-\u003emab_chosen_tot = 0;\n\n    // Increment selection count for the chosen heuristic\n    solver-\u003emab_select[solver-\u003eheuristic]++;\n\n    // Clear per-variable chosen counts for the next phase\n    for (all_variables(idx)) {\n        solver-\u003emab_chosen[idx] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}]},"finishReason":"STOP"}]},"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
